results.name: ui/initialize result carries hostContext
results.caveat: SHOULD, not MUST — a host may legitimately omit hostContext, which would FAIL here. We assert presence; a richer version would only validate shape when present.

results.name: restrictive CSP default blocks undeclared origin
results.caveat: A generic fetch failure (CORS/network) is indistinguishable here from a real CSP block. Hardening: listen for a `securitypolicyviolation` event, and pair with `security/csp-allow-declared` (needs a CSP-declaring resource) as a positive control.

results.name: host proxies tools/call to the server
results.caveat: The server also sees this call directly, so it can be corroborated server-side.

results.name: host rejects app call to a model-only tool
results.caveat: Covers the app→tool direction only. The complementary `visibility/app-tool-hidden` (tool absent from the *agent's* list) needs the agent vantage and isn't measurable here.
results.message: host must reject an app's tools/call for a tool lacking "app" visibility

results.name: ui/request-display-mode returns the resulting mode
results.caveat: Requests the current mode ('inline') to avoid a disruptive change, but a host may still re-render as a side effect.

results.name: host and sandbox have different origins
results.caveat: Inferred from a cross-origin SecurityError. If the page were opened top-level (no host), parent === self and this would FAIL — which is correct (it's not in a host).
results.message: reading window.parent.location must throw (cross-origin sandbox proxy)

results.name: sandbox grants allow-scripts + allow-same-origin
results.caveat: Inferred: scripts executing ⇒ allow-scripts; non-opaque window.origin ⇒ allow-same-origin.

results.name: host sends tool-input after initialize
results.caveat: Captured via the ontoolinput callback (registered before connect). TIMEOUT means the host never sent it for the launching tool.

results.name: host sends tool-result on completion
results.caveat: Captured via ontoolresult. Some hosts may not replay tool-result for the tool that launched the view — TIMEOUT flags that.

results.name: host does not switch to an undeclared display mode
results.caveat: We declare only inline/fullscreen in appCapabilities, then request the undeclared 'pip'.
results.message: host must not switch the view to a mode it didn't declare (pip)

results.name: unavailable mode request returns the current mode
results.caveat: SHOULD — assumes the current mode is stable between reading hostContext and the request.
